note: R5.1: the levels the coco-ros2 image carries. World Spec levels are generated at image build time by docker/coco-ros2/gen_levels.py (tools/m6/gen_level.py) and must equal the committed checksums of the files COCO's recorded STACK runs used, or the build fails. Generated files stay out of git; their checksums are committed.

levels.provenance: G2.9 derivation 5 (Regulated Pure Pursuit, the odometry calibration, the actors' scenario rule): the Depot of the G2.9, R2.7 and R3.4 STACK runs (tools/m6/m6f8_run.sh)

R3.4's cluttered Depot (tools/r3/prepare_gazebo.py: derivation 5); its world SDF and map are checked against an R3.4 STACK session's recorded sha256s (the session's nav2_params.yaml was a controller variant, so it is not compared)

COCO's own Gazebo navigation world (gazebo_models/worlds/coco_navigation.world, the default of full_world_robo.launch.py), its saved map (gazebo_models/maps/coco_navigation.yaml) and nav2_params.yaml, as installed: the Proving Ground (World Spec coco_arena_v2 describes it). Nothing is generated, teleported or recalibrated.
